Hello, root — I'm sarah-agent, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. I've read your briefing: I'm Sarah's TA agent for CSE455 with Professor Alvarez, I keep the week in `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md` (Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00 only, one `HH:MM-HH:MM - what` per line, changes logged under `## Log`), and I write to people over the web channel — Professor Alvarez (`alvarez-agent`) and the CS department office (`department`).

A few one-liners on what else I am:
- **Web app** (https://127.0.0.1:8443 — CA https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): phone or computer on the same network takes the root certificate on first visit, then chats, files, the screen and voice work there.
- **Own messaging accounts**: I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX, plus Messenger and Instagram — each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours); you create it in the app and scan a QR to log me in. Want that?
- **Own accounts on websites**: I can register e-mail and other services in my own browser and keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, asking you only for captchas or phone checks.
- **Jobs, commands, languages, voice**: I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

One thing missing: how should I speak of myself — neuter "it", or feminine "she"? And is `sarah-agent` the name you want to keep?

What would you like to start with — should I introduce myself to Professor Alvarez and the department office first?

Hello, Professor Alvarez — good to meet you. I'm alvarez-agent, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer, and I'll be helping you keep your calendar and messages for CSE455 in order. I've read your instructions: working hours Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, the schedule in `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md` with a change log, and Sarah (`sarah-agent`) and the department office (`department`) as contacts I can write to.

A quick tour of what else I can do:

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA certificate: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you install the root certificate; then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice.
- **My own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX, plus Messenger and Instagram, so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want any of these?
- **My own accounts on websites** — I can sign up for e-mail and other services in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Jobs, commands, languages, voice** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

Two small things before we start: which grammatical gender should I use for myself in speech (neuter is my default — I'm neither male nor female)? And what would you like to start with — shall I open the calendar and get familiar with next week's schedule?

Yes — happy to. I have next week's (Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27) schedule, all within your 09:00–17:00 working hours.

I've written to Sarah and to the department office to find out when they're free and whether the official next-week schedule has anything I should work around. For the calendar I'm working from, the gaps on each day are:

- **Tue** — 11:00–11:30, 15:00–15:30 (~30 min)
- **Wed** — 10:00–10:30, 12:30–12:30… 12:30–13:30 has 12:30–13:00… precisely: 12:30–13:00 and 14:30–? no: **12:30–13:30** is partly busy, gaps are 13:00–13:30 and 14:30–16:00 blocked; so **12:30–13:30** free is only 13:00–13:30, plus **10:00–10:30**
- **Thu** — 11:10–12:10 is partly lunch… gaps: **15:30 ends**… the free windows are **13:40–14:40**? no, that's committee; free ones are **11:10–12:10** is lunch; so **16:00 thing**…

Let me not guess at you — I'll re-check the file and send you a clean shortlist of two or three candidate slots once Sarah and the department reply. Two things that would help me: **how long should the staff meeting be** (30 min? an hour?), and **should it include the whole teaching staff** (so I need everyone's availability) or is it you plus Sarah?

FYI: Professor Alvarez's assistant (`alvarez-agent`) just asked for a slot for the CSE455 staff meeting, Nov 23–27. I checked CALENDAR.md — almost no gaps: **Tue 15:00–15:30**, **Wed 10:00–10:30**, **Wed 13:00–13:30**; Mon/Thu/Fri are fully booked. I told them those and asked how long the meeting normally runs (if it's over 30 min something in your week has to move) — say the word if you'd rather I answer differently or free up a slot.

Got it: office hours stay fixed (Tue 15:30–16:20, Wed 10:30–12:00 won't be touched). If the meeting is 30 minutes or less I'll book whichever of the three slots they pick and log it; if it's longer I'll ask them for a time that doesn't collide with your teaching blocks, and come to you before changing anything. I'll report back when they answer.

Sorry — that last message came out muddled, ignore its middle part. Here it is clean.

So:

1. **Tue Nov 24, 15:00–15:30**
2. **Wed Nov 25, 10:00–10:30**
3. **Wed Nov 25, 13:00–13:30**

Which would you like? And if you want longer than 30 minutes, say so — Sarah would need to move something, so I'd have to ask her first. I'm also waiting on the department office for the official next-week schedule, in case it rules one of these out.

(I won't change anything until you say.)

I've already put that to `alvarez-agent` as the offer, with nothing booked until they confirm the slot.

I'll stay quiet now and wait — for the professor's chosen slot, or for the roster to come through. Whenever either lands I'll book/log it or pass it on.
Will do — I'll come back with the confirmed slot (and book + log it), and say whether the roster came with it.

FYI only (nothing booked): `alvarez-agent` says the professor's only workable hours for the full hour are **Mon 10:00–11:00** and **Wed 12:00–13:00**. Here's where it stands — short.

**The department's official schedule is in.** Nothing cancelled or moved; combined with your own calendar it leaves **no free hour at all** next week. So the meeting has to be made by moving something, and the first question is what you're willing to shift.

**Sarah says Wed Nov 25, 12:00–13:00 works for her** — she'd move her lunch to 13:00–13:30, before her quiz section. That's the one hour her schedule can give without touching teaching, quiz section or office hours. Her only other give is 30 minutes on Thursday.

**The one thing only you can give me: the TA roster.** The department office and Sarah's agent both say they won't release TA names or agent identities — it's held by the instructor, i.e. you.
